name: Burnt Walnut Bisque
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Make custard of milk, eggs, one-third of the sugar, and salt.
Caramelize remaining sugar, add nut meats, and turn into a slightly buttered pan.
Cool, pound, and pass through a purée strainer.
Add to custard, cool, then add one cup heavy cream, beaten until stiff, and vanilla.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
